reason: I already order through an app I know and it has mostly worked for me, so I'm not going to risk my money on a new name I've never heard of. For electronics I can still go to Shorja or Karrada and check the thing in my hand first.
objection: If a charger or car part turns out fake or doesn't fit, a new company could just say it's 'as ordered', and since there are no change-of-mind returns I'm stuck with it. I also have to wait 2 to 3 weeks for it.
would_change_my_mind: A friend I trust ordering from them a few times without problems, and their total fees coming in clearly cheaper than my current service on the same item.
